ablation_scope.compared_component: three arms: deterministic rules; deterministic rules plus optional LLM fallback; and deterministic rules with contracts, risk gates, and learned-rule memory
ablation_scope.candidate_acceptance: Model candidates remain unaccepted. Executable validity and expected-output matches are separate metrics. human reviewer effort is not collected and is reported as null.
ablation_scope.learned_rule_protocol: The safeguards arm seeds its local learned-rule store from development cases only, then evaluates held-out cases. No held-out case is used to teach a later held-out case.
shared_mechanisms: risk-aware finite validation and contract reporting are part of the common translator path and cannot be disabled safely; this experiment does not estimate their individual causal effects
limitations: The pilot has only two held-out task groups and project-authored task adaptations; results are descriptive, not a generalization estimate.
ablation_scope.live_provider_replayability: Provider-enabled runs can vary across requests. Candidate hashes, provider/model/prompt metadata, request IDs, and case results are recorded; they do not make model generation deterministic.
